'''"Marsune and Gallo"''' was a game played by [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] children in [[Tree/Legends|forests]] and [[Swamp/Legends|swamps]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], after<ref name="GB" /> the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3000 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" /> The game recreated the story of two legendary figures in Gungan history, [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Gallo/Legends|Gallo]] and [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Marsune (Gungan)|Marsune]],<ref name="GB" /> who in 3,000 BBY<ref name="TEA" /> ended a [[War of the Gungan tribes|war]] between the Gungan tribes by uniting them against [[Rogoe/Legends|Rogoe]], the [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] that instigated the conflict.<ref name="GB" />

==Behind the scenes==
"Marsune and Gallo" was mentioned in the databank entry for Marsune in the [[2001]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''. The game was based on the missions completed by the player in the first three levels of the Gungan campaign.<ref name="GB" />
